rationale: The agent verified the user via name/ZIP lookup and retrieved user/order details, but then executed returns and a cancellation without first confirming each order-changing action. Critically, it canceled the entire pending order #W2575533 despite the user specifying only to cancel the hose item and to do nothing if item-level cancellation wasn’t possible. This violates the user’s intent and the policy requirement to confirm before writes. The refund total provided depends on those unauthorized actions. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
